problem: Legacy process-repair-jobs sent capture results directly to canonical finish while raw HTML existed only locally. Official Edge uploaded raw but did not read it back before completion. A completed capture could therefore lack, or not yet prove, its canonical private archive.

changes.cli: RPC mode now refuses immediately with finite_ticket_edge_capture_required, before directory creation, service IO or lease even when service credentials are configured. Canonical capture must use existing finite-ticket Edge admission. No new ticket-minting/admission mechanism, service-key bypass or privileged direct-completion callback remains in CLI.
changes.offline: Local capture uses existing DNS-pinned/SSRF/robots/size/deadline controls, fresh empty directory and finishJob=null. Output and retained summary explicitly say non_authoritative=true/database_results_persisted=false. Historical finish-research-results.sql filename contains only a RAISE EXCEPTION, never geography_repair_finish. No local raw archive or historic cached SQL can become approved canonical completion through this CLI.
changes.edge: Official callback snapshots original returned leased job IDs and leases before runner receives mutable jobs. It snapshots exact completion payload before asynchronous work, hashes canonical JSON, then archives each exact captured raw hash, independently reads bounded bytes back and verifies exact SHA+size. Only then does it invoke unchanged canonical geography_repair_finish with the original job and lease.
changes.completion_once: One matching original promise per job/payload; identical repetitions return original promise without redispatch. Altered payload or wrong job/lease refuses. Conflicts detected before archive work or canonical finish dispatch invalidate pending completion. An unknown original completion remains a rejected original promise and is not retried. A conflict after an already-dispatched operation cannot undo canonical history; it refuses a second dispatch and requires reconciliation.
changes.acknowledgement: Missing/unknown finish status, unexpected coordinate_writes, rejected current lease or ambiguous dispatch never produce a success claim. Input_changed is a recognized zero-factual-write completion acknowledgement and grants no point/source authority. Canonical idempotency/current row authority remains in unchanged SQL; later non-finish statuses require reconciliation.
changes.existing_test_fixture: Mock retains uploaded bodies by content hash/path and returns matching bytes. It supplies canonical-style finish status/zero-write acknowledgement and consistent returned leased job identity. All original assertions remain, adding upload→readback→finish order. Deliberate wrong/corrupt readback tests preserved; no blanket successful archive responses.
